if (total <= 3) return { kind: 'row', pip: 9, gap: 2 };
  return { kind: 'one', pip: 10 };
why: Four players at four and five stocks lose the one-pip fallback and draw a row of 9px pips. Measured on the real HUD at 390px, even a row at the 8px floor puts a teams strip 3.2px and 43.2px past the topbar's content edge, and an FFA strip, which also carries the identity mark, 18.1px and 58.1px; 9px pips are wider still. The fallback -- one full-size pip and the count -- is #838's, and #1055 measured that a teams entry needs it at exactly these two cells, keeping its letter. The FFA pips cases already caught this before #1055 (2 tests failed); the teams cases name the teams half of the same contract.
